title: AAI NR Recruitment 2026 – Graduate Apprentice, Diploma Apprentice, ITI Trade Apprentice Posts
shortInfo: AAI NR has announced notification for Graduate Apprentice, Diploma Apprentice, ITI Trade Apprentice posts. Required qualification: Degree, Diploma, ITI. Last date to apply: 16-09-26.
howToApply: Visit BOAT’s/RDAT’s web portal: www.nats.education.gov.in (for Graduate/Diploma Apprentices) or www.apprenticeshipindia.org (for ITI Trade Apprentices).
Register yourself on the concerned portal (NATS/NAPS) prior to applying for apprenticeship training in AAI.
Find establishment: Airports Authority of India – RHQ NR, New Delhi (NDLSWC000002(BOAT) / E05200700101(NAPS)) and click on the Apply button.
Complete your profile with all required details including educational qualifications, communication details, and training preferences.
Upload required documents including qualifying degree/provisional certificate in PDF format.
After successful application, the portal will display the message: ‘Successfully applied for the training position. Based on availability, you will be contacted by the establishment.’
Candidates applying for more than one discipline will not be considered and their application will be rejected.
No Application Fee is being charged.

title: JKSSB Recruitment 2026 – Junior lab Technician, Junior Staff Nurse, Junior Pharmacist, MMPHW, Jr Laboratory Asst & Other Posts
shortInfo: JKSSB has announced notification for Junior lab Technician, Junior Staff Nurse, Junior Pharmacist, MMPHW, Jr Laboratory Asst & Other posts. Required qualification: Matriculation to Graduate degree with Science. Last date to apply: 09-10-26.
howToApply: Visit the official JKSSB website, www.jkssb.nic.in, and go through the Advertisement Notification and instructions carefully.
Fill the online application form; applications through any other mode will not be accepted.
Clearly indicate the item number(s)/post(s) being applied for; only one application per item number is allowed.
Upload a live photograph, signature (10 KB–20 KB), category certificate (max 100 KB PDF), and qualification/experience certificates (self-attested, max 100 KB PDF) as required for the post.
Pay the applicable application fee online through Net Banking, Credit Card, or Debit Card.
Review all entries carefully before final submission, since no changes are entertained after submission.
Take a printout of the submitted application form and preserve it for Document Verification; do not submit the hard copy to the JKSSB office in person, by post, or by email.

In-service candidates must additionally forward a signed and stamped printout of the application, along with the certificate at the end of the form, through their Head of Department to the Secretary, JKSSB, by the last date of Document Verification.
